title: Influence bound from noise sensitivity
statement: Let $n\ge 2$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and let $E\in\mathbb R$. If the probability that $f$ changes under noise that independently flips each coordinate with probability $1/n$ is at most $E$, then the total influence of the real-valued sign representation of $f$ is at most $\displaystyle \frac{2}{1-e^{-2}}\,nE$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
Noise sensitivity at per-coordinate flip probability $1/n$ is at most $E$
